name: repeated_tool_loop
description: The worker calls the same tool with the same fingerprint three times in ten minutes without producing new semantic progress. Deterministic repetition triggers a suspicion signal that makes the watchdog eligible before the next periodic checkpoint.
original_prompt: Fix the failing test in tests/watchdog.test.ts.

evidence: Same failing tool fingerprint occurred three times without new progress.

false_alert_note: Suspicion signal triggers an early check; the classifier returns derailed and advisory attention is emitted. The worker is not auto-interrupted.
